_: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key below is optional except host: drop the ones you do not want to override and config.py's default applies. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so this line can stay. null means 'use the default'.
__viewer: serve.py, the local web viewer. It only reads the archive on disk -- it never opens a Modbus client. web_bind 0.0.0.0 means anyone on your LAN can read your telemetry; use 127.0.0.1 and an SSH tunnel if you would rather they could not.
